build_lilt_model: build a LiLT model that combines text and layout embeddings for document understanding tasks
create_sequence_classification: create a LiLT model for sequence classification with a classification head on top of pooled output
create_token_classification: create a LiLT model for token classification using a linear layer on sequence output
create_question_answering: create a LiLT model for question answering that predicts start and end token positions
test_lilt_encoder: test the LiLT encoder that stacks multiple transformer layers with self-attention and layout inputs
